contentsAreWeightless.label: Are Contents Weightless?
contentsAreWeightless.hint: When enabled, contained items weigh nothing for the carrier (e.g. a bag of holding).

maxContentWeight.label: Max Content Weight
maxContentWeight.hint: Maximum weight this container can hold. Leave blank for no hard limit.

isPsionic.label: Is Psionic
isPsionic.hint: Whether this item is psionic in nature.

isEpic.label: Is Epic
isEpic.hint: Whether this item is of epic level.

ITEM.UsesNameFromFormula: This Item will have a name updated based on a special formula. You can tweak it and see how it is defined by unlocking custom attributes panel.
ITEM.MagicEquivalentDescription: Material Magic Equivalent is used then determining minimum Enhancement bonus to weapon if a character has a Damage Reduction set to X/Material
ITEM.IsCurseActiveHint: Whether the curse on this item is currently active.

current.label: Current HP
current.hint: The current hit points of this item.

max.label: Max HP
max.hint: The maximum hit points of this item.

hardness.label: Hardness
hardness.hint: How resistant this item is to damage.

quantity.label: Quantity
quantity.hint: The number of this item in the stack.

weight.label: Weight
weight.hint: The weight of a single unit of this item, in pounds.

isCarried.label: Carried
isCarried.hint: Whether this item is currently being carried by the owner.

price.label: Price
price.hint: The purchase price of this item.

isBroken.label: Is Broken
isBroken.hint: Whether this item is currently broken.

containerUuid.label: Container UUID
containerUuid.hint: The UUID of the container this item is stored in, if any.

hpAdjusted.label: Item HP Adjusted
hpAdjusted.description: Triggered when the hit points of this item are adjusted.

damageTaken.label: Item Damaged
damageTaken.description: Triggered when this item takes damage.

damageMended.label: Item Mended
damageMended.description: Triggered when this item is mended.

itemBroken.label: Item Broken
itemBroken.description: Triggered when this item becomes broken.

itemRepaired.label: Item Repaired
itemRepaired.description: Triggered when this item is repaired.

isEquipped.label: Equipped
isEquipped.hint: Whether this item is currently equipped.

isMelded.label: Melded?
isMelded.hint: Whether this item is currently melded into the body.

designedForSize.label: Designed For Size
designedForSize.hint: The size category this item is designed for. This may affect the item's stats and which characters can equip it.

isWeightlessWhenEquipped.label: Weightless When Equipped
isWeightlessWhenEquipped.hint: If checked, this item does not contribute weight when equipped.

equippedSlotIds.label: Equipped Slots
equippedSlotIds.hint: The equipment slots this item occupies when equipped.

isMasterwork.label: Masterwork?
isMasterwork.hint: Whether this item is of masterwork quality.

isBroken.label: Broken?
isBroken.hint: Whether this item is currently broken.

magicEquivalency.label: Magic Equivalency
magicEquivalency.hint: The magic equivalency granted to this item.

itemEquipped.label: Item Equipped
itemEquipped.description: Triggered when this item is equipped.

itemUnequipped.label: Item Unequipped
itemUnequipped.description: Triggered when this item is unequipped.
